rawContent: Some of y'all are defending the police still. I'm starting to think it's not b/c you actually trust them. You think being on their side will protect you b/c you see how violent they can be. It won't. #blacklivesmatter

I'm starting to understand now why my immigrant parents gave up on trying to change things. Why would they? Seeing how we handle people of color when I was born in 1992 right after the Rodney King LA Riots and then only 27 years later it happens again. #blacklivesmatter
